english.note: Use this when success, power, or excitement makes someone elated and overconfident rather than literally intoxicated.

examples.english: He got drunk with success after winning the competition and went around saying he was the best.
examples.traditional: 佢一贏咗比賽就得意忘形，周圍話自己最叻。
